title: Bobby Fischer's claim that Russian parapsychologists interfered with his games

tellings.quote: Bobby Fischer was tired of saying that the Russians did this to him. Bobby Fischer, look it up. That he would play and they would come in and there were gurus, Russian parasychologists

plain: The American chess champion Bobby Fischer said again and again that the Russians interfered with his games by bringing in gurus and Russian parapsychologists, people who study claimed psychic powers, while he played. The surgeon Italo Venturelli repeats this to Michels, telling him to "look it up." If true, it would mean the Soviets used psychic methods in open competition during the 1970s.
